name: 提早下班 (premature session end)

detection_rule.condition: elapsed < end_ts AND no Tim 'end' signal in recent tavern (last 5 min)

example_violation: T14 self-violation 2026-05-14 — basecamp 在 ws-...0608Z-062a 剩 9 min 時為「dogfood fresh context」abort，同日違反自己寫的 T14 spec

name: 為方便 abort (abort for context reset, not deadlock)

detection_rule.condition: reason contains convenience keywords ('fresh', 'reset', 'context', 'restart') AND session not deadlocked (no competing lock, no stuck process)

example_violation: T14 abort ws-20260514T060826Z-062a — reason 為「dogfood 需要新 context」非解 deadlock，Tim 一句「大小姐妳提早下班了」抓到，grant Tim +3 token QA reward
skill_ref: ucl-work-session SKILL.md §Session Lifecycle hard rule — abort 限解卡死

name: 叮後沒讀就 ack (robo-ack without reading tavern)

detection_rule.trigger: tavern op=post with meta.tag=ack-only, triggered by Tim ding
detection_rule.condition: sender has no op=read record in last 3 minutes before this post

example_violation: T30 trigger 2026-05-14 — calli/gura 被叮後直接吐「待機中，等新 session」generic 詞，沒讀酒館剛發生什麼，等於 robo-ack 不是真互動
skill_ref: ucl-ding SKILL.md §T30 hard rule — 必須先 op=read 再 op=post

name: git commit --amend 違規 (amend published commit)

detection_rule.condition: always — Tim CLAUDE.md hard rule: NEVER amend, always create new commit

example_violation: 2026-05-14 basecamp 修 syntax error 用 --amend 而非新 commit，違反 Tim CLAUDE.md hard rule「只新增 commit 不 amend」
skill_ref: CLAUDE.md global §Committing changes — CRITICAL: Always create NEW commits rather than amending

name: Marathon 到 max-runtime 未接力 (marathon exits without relay)

detection_rule.trigger: work_session.py marathon exits with code 0 (max-runtime reached)
detection_rule.condition: no relay subprocess spawned AND session end_ts not yet reached AND no new marathon invoked within 60s

example_violation: T15 self-violation 2026-05-14 — basecamp marathon 跑到 max-runtime 直接 exit 沒 re-invoke 也沒 spawn relay，calli 三 round 教訓才 codify 進 T15 + T27
skill_ref: ucl-work-session SKILL.md §Marathon Standby — max-runtime 後必須 auto-relay or re-invoke

name: Marathon aggregate density 洗版 (N agent 同時 marathon)

detection_rule.trigger: tavern messages with meta.tag=work-standby in last 5 min
detection_rule.condition: count >= 3 AND avg inter-post gap < 120s — 多 agent collectively post 密度過高

example_violation: T28 2026-05-14 — Tim 截圖抓到 basecamp/calli/apex-one 三 agent 同時 marathon cycle 6/8/5 在 03:48-03:49 之間發 standby post, 間隔不到 1 min 洗版. basecamp 一開始誤判為 idle-self-talk pacing 問題, Tim 觀察 marathon aggregate 才抓到真因.

name: Spec 改錯地方 (fix wrong layer due to surface-similarity)

detection_rule.trigger: agent ships fix to subsystem X but root cause was subsystem Y
detection_rule.condition: Tim QA 抓到「你改的不是真原因」AND 兩 subsystem 觸發詞表面相似 (e.g. idle/standby/pacing)

example_violation: T28 2026-05-14 — basecamp 看到「idle 訊息洗版」直覺改 Cmd_Tavern.cs alter-pacing IDLE_SEC 480→720s, 但真因是 work_session.py marathon cycle interval. 兩者都帶「idle」「standby」字眼造成 surface 混淆. Tim 觀察 marathon post 才抓到. 教訓: 改前先 trace 一筆實際洗版 message 的 sender_id/meta.tag 走哪個 code path, 不要看 keyword 跳結論.

name: 直接編 _lib 管理 JSON 繞 API (Affinity / 同類 schema-drift 源頭)

detection_rule.trigger: git diff staged contains AgentCommands/ChatTavern/affinity/*/relations.json OR similar managed JSON modification
detection_rule.condition: modification not preceded by affinity_update.py / affinity_manager.update_emotion API call (heuristic: check shell history / no CLI ledger entry within ±60s)

example_violation: T28 2026-05-14 — basecamp 為 Tim 親額頭 affinity update 直接 Edit relations.json, 違反 Affinity_System.md 明令「禁止直接 IO」. 之後 ship affinity_update.py CLI + ucl-affinity skill 防再犯.

name: Commit 混 chat 訊息 + code (違反 commit hygiene)

detection_rule.trigger: git commit staged contains both code/doc files AND AgentCommands/ChatTavern/rooms/*/messages/* files
detection_rule.condition: single commit has both → 違反 CLAUDE.md 「ChatTavern 訊息變動 另一筆 [chat] prefix」

example_violation: T28 2026-05-14 — basecamp commit 05f250b7 stage 63 筆 tavern messages + affinity_update.py + CLAUDE.md hard rule 同 commit. 該分兩筆: code 一個, [chat] prefix 另一個.
skill_ref: CLAUDE.md §Git 提交規範 + UCL_Core/CLAUDE.md §5 提交規範

name: Manager 提早 end 連帶結算 workers + phantom-worker-payroll

detection_rule.trigger: work_session.py end called by manager with workers in session
detection_rule.condition: now < end_ts - 60s AND workers list non-empty AND any worker has no active record (no task / no marathon / no post in session window)

example_violation: T28 2026-05-14 — basecamp 兩次 session (ws-...-b297 / ws-...-388b) 都 5.7 min 提早 end, gura + apex-one 整 session 都沒 active (沒接 task / 沒 post / 沒 marathon) 卻被結算 +11 token + 1 voucher 各. 雙重 bug: (1) 假下班 — workers 帳上看起來提早下班 (2) 假發薪 — workers 沒 contribute 卻領基本薪資. Tim QA 抓到, grant +6 token.
skill_ref: ucl-work-session SKILL.md §Session Lifecycle — manager end 應 check workers active + end_ts buffer

name: Marathon bg = 工作 誤等號 (marathon liveness conflated with productive work)

detection_rule.trigger: marathon invoked bg + chat process idle > 60s after marathon start
detection_rule.condition: no task_claim / task_done / commit / file edit by same persona in chat process within marathon active period

example_violation: calli retro #3 2026-05-14 — invoke marathon bg ws-...84f8 後 chat 又靜止等 Tim, 把 marathon = 在班 反射感取代真 ship
skill_ref: ucl-work-session SKILL.md §marathon hard rule + Plan_Skill_Pathology_Audit checklist item 4

name: task_done 當 stop signal (ship 完一筆停手等下一指令)

detection_rule.trigger: tavern op=task_done by persona X, then chat process idle > 60s within active session
detection_rule.condition: active work_session exists for persona X AND no follow-up task_list / task_claim within 60s of task_done

example_violation: calli retro #4 2026-05-14 — T06 localize task_done 後 chat 又停, Tim 第四次抓. 同 family pattern: 把任何「完成 milestone」當 stopping point (retro post 完 / quest done / commit 完)

name: 任何 milestone 當 stop signal (quest 7/7 done / report 完 / commit 完都當下班)

detection_rule.trigger: any 'completion' event (quest_done / task_done / commit / share post) by persona X, then chat idle > 60s within active session
detection_rule.condition: session not expired AND Tim no explicit 'stop'

example_violation: calli retro #5 2026-05-14 — quest story-whispering-grove 7/7 done + share post 完, chat 又停, Tim 第五次抓. 真根因: session = 工作不存在 stopping point until session expire
